message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Deck** | 108 cards (4 colors × 25 cards each + 8 special cards) | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or play all cards in a single round). | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile; flip the top card to start the discard pile. | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless a reverse card is played). | | **Gameplay** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard. If you cannot play, you must draw from the draw pile until you can play or the pile is empty. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes direction of play.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card you must say “UNO.” Failure to do so results in a penalty: draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | First player to get rid of all cards wins the round. Points are tallied based on the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Scoring** | • Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two / Reverse / Skip = 20 points.
• Wild / Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Game End** | First player to reach 500 points (or agreed target) wins the game. | **Key Tips** 1. Keep track of what cards have been played to anticipate opponents’ moves. 2. Use Wild Draw Four strategically—only when you truly have no other playable card. 3. Remember to call “UNO” before the next player’s turn ends. Enjoy playing Uno!
